items.title: Kurt Westergaard
items.summary: Kurt Westergaard was a Danish cartoonist. He was known for creating the controversial cartoon of a terrorist, although not the Islamic prophet Muhammad, wearing a bomb in his turban. Westergaard was born in Døstrup, Denmark.

items.title: Sean Patrick Maloney
items.summary: Sean Patrick Maloney is an American lawyer and politician who has been the United States Ambassador to the OECD since 2024. He was the U.S. representative from New York's 18th congressional district from 2013 to 2023. He is a member of the Democratic Party.
